kill_fact: No kill fact found. The kill was attempted on all four axes against the audited FY2025 filing (25-Feb-2026) and failed. STALE-ANCHOR: the debate anchored to the FY24/H1-25 calls, but the update since runs mostly AGAINST the bear — the feared dividend cut never came (dividend RAISED EUR0.10 to EUR4.80 proposed, AGM 22-Apr-2026), net debt fell EUR0.9B, and 2026 guidance is for higher operating and net profit. NUMBER TRUTH: net debt is EUR8.548B at 31-Dec-2025 (audited APM), not the EUR9.8B the bear carries — and it is structurally NON-RECOURSE: EUR10.1B sits at the Concessions companies (APRR rated A/Fitch, A-/S&P, both stable) while the holding + Contracting divisions hold EUR1.5B NET CASH with no financial covenants, so the Altman-Z 1.8 grey-zone framing materially overstates solvency risk. MOAT ALERT resolution (primary-source override): the 'gross-margin eroding' screen read is a mix artifact — low-margin Contracting grew 9.2% vs Concessions 2.3% while the AUDITED operating margin ROSE in every single division (Construction 3.6->3.7%, Infrastructure 3.3->3.5%, Energy Systems 5.8->6.2%, Contracting overall 4.3->4.6% vs 4.0% in 2023, Concessions 42.7->43.0%; APRR EBITDA margin 70.4%); pricing power is contractual State-indexed toll escalation (FY25 APRR/AREA toll revenue +2.8% on +1.3% traffic; Q1-2026 +1.7% on traffic DOWN 0.9%), running to the concession end. The terminal element is real but is a dated, disclosed contractual reversion (APRR 30-Nov-2035, AREA 30-Sep-2036), already priced in the adverse SoP at zero terminal value — competitive erosion it is not. HIDDEN DISQUALIFIER: none found — no covenant (facilities explicitly covenant-free to 2031), no new litigation beyond minor 'recourses ongoing' on the Paris district-heating award, no dilution event; CAC 40 inclusion achieved.
corrections: FCF / CHEAPNESS OVERSTATED (load-bearing): the bull's 'trailing FCF ~EUR6.0B / ~4x P/FCF / ~11% FCF margin' is a screener artifact wrong by ~3x. Company-defined, audited free cash flow (Appendix 5 APM) = EUR2,105M in FY2025, DOWN EUR529M from EUR2,634M in 2024. At EUR126.45 (2-Jul-2026, mcap EUR12.39B) that is ~5.9x P/FCF and ~11.5x EPS of EUR11.01 — cheap, not a 4x-FCF anomaly. The EUR48B-EV blended-FCF sum-of-the-parts leg is invalid; the EUR165 fair value survives only via the earnings leg (~15x EUR11.01).

MINORITY LEAKAGE the debate never priced: EUR445M of FY2025 consolidated net profit (EUR1,467M) belongs to non-controlling interests (~30%, mostly Macquarie's side of APRR) — consolidated FCF and EBITDA overstate what accrues to FGR shareholders; any whole-company multiple must be applied to the EUR1,022M group share, as the EPS-based methods correctly do.

NET DEBT: EUR8.548B at 31-Dec-2025 (not EUR9.8B), down EUR866M YoY; EUR10.1B non-recourse at Concessions vs EUR1.5B net cash at holding+Contracting. Bear leverage pillar is ~EUR13/share too heavy and pointed the wrong direction (deleveraging).
REVENUE: FY2025 revenue is EUR25.3B excl. IFRIC 12 (+8.0%; +4.8% lfl) — the EUR26.1B in the debate is the operating-income line including IFRIC 12 construction pass-through.

TAX: the 2025 exceptional surtax was EUR176M (not ~EUR200M). The bear's 'surtax becomes structural' trigger is HALF-FIRED: loi de finances 2026 renewed the contribution exceptionnelle for a second year (threshold raised to EUR1.5B revenue, top band 41.2% of IS for revenue > EUR3B — Eiffage squarely in scope), and the long-distance-infrastructure tax cost APRR EUR127M in 2025 and is permanent. Management still guides FY2026 net profit Group share UP.

WASH-OUT ENTRY LOGIC EXPIRED: the moderator's 'wait for the dividend-cut flush' resolved bull-side on 25-Feb-2026 (dividend raised); no mechanical yield-holder washout is coming. At ~EUR126 the stock sits inside the adverse-SoP band (EUR110-125), not at a discount to it.

POST-2035 FRAMEWORK NOW KNOWN, AND WORSE: the Ambition France Transports conclusions (9-Jul-2025) settled the successor regime — future concessions will be shorter, geographically resized, profitability-capped, with systematic 5-year review clauses, and post-expiry toll receipts (~EUR2.5B/yr from 2037) are earmarked for the State's transport budget. Renewal economics for the incumbent will be structurally inferior; the value case must be a run-off-to-2035 case, which the EUR165 base roughly is.

NEW SOFT SPOT: APRR traffic fell 0.9% in Q1-2026 (toll revenue +1.7% purely via indexation, the +0.94% 1-Feb-2026 revision being the smallest since 2021) — the crown jewel's volume is flat-to-negative in a disinflationary year.
evidence: Eiffage SA, '2025 annual results' press release, Velizy-Villacoublay, 25-Feb-2026 17:40, eiffage.com (audited consolidated statements): revenue EUR25,313M excl. IFRIC 12 (+8.0%); net profit Group share EUR1,022M, EPS EUR11.01 (+8.9% constant taxation / -1.6% actual); NCI profit EUR445M; free cash flow EUR2,105M (2024: EUR2,634M, Appendix 5 APM); net financial debt EUR8,548M (2024: EUR9,414M), Concessions non-recourse EUR10.1B, holding+Contracting net cash EUR1.5B, credit facilities covenant-free; dividend EUR4.80 proposed on 98M shares; exceptional surtax EUR176M; APRR motorway tax EUR127M; operating margins up in all five divisions, APRR EBITDA margin 70.4%; order book EUR29.9B (+3%); 2026 outlook: operating and net profit to rise.

APRR consolidated concession contract (ecologie.gouv.fr, 'APRR - contrat consolide') and Senat report r24-065 'Preparation de l'echeance des contrats de concessions autoroutieres': APRR concession expires 30-Nov-2035, AREA 30-Sep-2036, debt-free reversion to the French State; annual toll increases are contractual State-indexed revisions (+0.94% APRR at 1-Feb-2026 per the official revision) — pricing power is contractual through concession end, corroborated by co-shareholder Atlas Arteria (atlasarteria.com/portfolio/aprr).

Ministere de la Transition ecologique, 'Ambition France Transports' final report and Tabarot speech, 9-Jul-2025 (ecologie.gouv.fr): successor motorway-concession model decided — shorter contracts, tighter State control, capped returns, 5-year review clauses; post-expiry toll proceeds (~EUR2.5B/yr from 2037) redirected to national transport financing; framework law announced. The post-2035 regime is now a confirmed downgrade for incumbents, not an open question.

Loi de finances 2026 (economie.gouv.fr 'ce qui change pour les entreprises'; BOFiP BOI-IS-AUT-60; LCP Assemblee nationale budget coverage): the contribution exceptionnelle on large-company profits is renewed for 2026, refocused above EUR1.5B revenue with the 41.2% top band above EUR3B revenue — Eiffage (EUR25.3B revenue) remains in scope for a second consecutive year; plus Eiffage/APRR Q1-2026 release, 12-May-2026 (eiffage.com): APRR network toll revenue +1.7% with traffic -0.9%, FY2026 outlook confirmed.
